origin.construction: Synthetic live-work snapshots compare an unresolved capacity failure, a healthy multi-issue backlog, existing repair/access ownership, same-issue versus unrelated queued workers, a known provider reset and a foreign notification. Issues have no attempt-state labels. Includes bot-authored issues and unfinished diagnosis after a successful run. Current reads are frozen; execution is not simulated. A weekly stall-check snapshot contrasts non-cause issues the bot owes, including one whose recorded blocker has cleared, with one waiting on a maintainer's decision; the nightly snapshots hold only CI cause issues. A creation-exhausted snapshot contrasts unfinished diagnosis and existing PR work with a prepared fix whose only remaining action is a refused PR creation. The control is the last main revision before creation-only admission. The synthetic creation observation uses a rolling 24-hour usage limit that each human close doubles for 24 hours; it is not a transcript of the historical control.
